biography: ## About :::DATA CENTER, COMMERCIAL & CORPORATE REAL ESTATE EXECUTIVE ::: An accomplished, financially and operationally driven commercial real estate executive, I offer broad-based expertise directing strategic planning, acquisition, disposition, holding, and transactional experience to support portfolio optimization and impact bottom-line profitability.
